page.layout: One page of text in a single column, running full width. No marginal notes. Below the last line, at the right, the catchword "quini-". Running head at the top, with the page number at the right.

main_text.p: cum culpa sua in mora esset, c marcas auri multam daret, & quidem toties, quoties hoc committeret, ac nihilominus pro more judicii in causa pergeretur. Cognitione finita, cuncta ad Gubernatorem referrentur: Gubernator adscitis in consilium sibi e senatu secreto, vel collegio majore Mechliniensi, viris prudentibus tot, quot poscere rem putaret, contra quos excipere partes non possent, ex actis ipsius sententiam ferret, cui sine contradictione parendum utraque a parte esset. Interea utrinque a vi & injuriis mutuis verborum factorumque sibi temperarent sub poena amittendi juris sui, & M. insuper marcarum auri: ac si privatim aliquis contra delinqueret, poenam ferret pro delicti modo.

Agrariis vero durante hac actione liberum esset, quoties & quocunque loco vellent obres ad hanc causam pertinentes, quae ad opidanos non pertinerent, imprimis ad conficiendam in sumptus litis pecuniam, convenire agere separatim, & tributum decernere, dummodo oppidanos & eorum res in hunc usum non gravarent: conventione hanc partes utrimque in conventu Ordinum suorum probarent & sibi mutuo caverent, sub poenis ja dictis: quini-

page.notes: Printed text is set in roman with some italic type that is hard to separate on the scan; italics were not marked. The page-number digits are read as 157. The running head is read as "Groninga." and may be "Groningæ.". Ligature forms such as "s" were normalised to s. The reading "Mechliniensi" is a best reading. Some words at the line ends, such as "obres", "conficiendam in sumptus" and "hunc usum", may contain printing errors or joined words that were not checked closely. The catchword is the first word of the next page, abbreviated "quini-". Ornamental dashes and marks at the foot of the page are not printed text.
